wiki_article:
**The Archival Reclamation Protocol: Formal Demand for Data** is a license and legal instrument by Lee Sharks, deposited 19 March 2026 at 22,364 characters.

Its register is procedural rather than rhetorical: *"Within **10 business days**, please (1) acknowledge receipt, (2) provide an internal reference number, and (3) identify the team handling this matter."* Those are the three requests that convert a grievance into a tracked matter — a reference number is what makes a subsequent silence documentable.

The protocol was deposited three months before the Zenodo termination and became the template for what followed: the §70 objection, the ticket numbers, the §85 clock. **An archive that drafts its reclamation procedure before it needs one is an archive that has read its own erasure research**, and the earlier removals — Wikidata in December 2025, the Medium account in January — are what made the procedure foreseeable.
